In summary, our research is concerned with
the following aspects:
the study of the effect of filtering in dense wavelength division multiplexed (DWDM) metropolitan area networks adopting VCSEL-based transmitters.
the study of the performance of a dense WDM metro network with VCSEL-based transmitters, taking into account the effect of filtering.

the filtering impact is a critical issue to be considered when designing and dimensioning dense WDM networks based on VCSEL-based transmitters.

filtering is a critical issue for the design of dense WDM metropolitan area networks adopting VCSELs, but it can be managed with the use of appropriate filtering and equalization techniques.
, in spite of the reduced cost of the transmitters, filtering effects can limit the performance in terms of transported data rate and, consequently, the overall cost of the system.

filtering effects can be mitigated by using a reduced number of VCSEL channels and a proper selection of the modulation format.
